We are Carlos (ENGINEERING) and Maynor (COMPUTER SCIENCE), both Junior Mudd Students. For our E155 project, we decided to make a portable DJ set. Using the MCU and FPGA, we were able to apply a high or low pass filter, plus either speed up or slow down the song playing. With a click of the joystick, you can also skip the current song playing to the next one, looping through 16 songs.

**Who did what:** Carlos built everything outside the microcontroller (the FPGA design, the audio DSP for the filters and playback speed, and all of the wiring), plus the joystick input code on the MCU. Maynor wrote the rest of the STM32 MCU firmware.
